mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision for the transport compression codec is zstd. It was chosen because it compresses better and decompresses considerably faster on both the sending and receiving sides.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md
